title: Assistant Costumer - Department of Dance
description:
Position Overview

The Assistant Costumer for the Department of Dance within Jordan
College of the Arts will assist the Costume Director in the
construction and maintenance of all Butler Ballet costumes and
wardrobe.

Responsibilities

Assist with the construction, refurbishment, and alteration of
costumes for Butler University’s Department of Dance, including
classical ballet and contemporary dance projects.
The assistant costumer will also help the Costumer with
wardrobe and costume storage, maintenance, and inventory.
Work with student stitchers to complete assigned projects.
Serve as Wardrobe crew for productions.
Other duties as qualified and required.
May occasionally operate University-owned vehicles or operate a
vehicle on the University’s behalf, to transport individuals,
equipment, materials, and supplies in support of departmental and
University activities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Fine Arts degree in theatre or
related field
Minimum of 3 years of costume work in dance and/or theatre at
the collegiate or professional level.
Advanced skills in sewing, alteration, fabric dyeing, pattern
reading, millinery, and tutu construction are required.
Training and experience in dance and /or theatre costuming at
the collegiate or professional level is required.
Accurate and efficient construction skills, good work habits,
passion for the work, strict adherence to published deadlines, and
commitment to excellence are required.
Additional skills in crafts, millinery, and dyeing are
desirable.
Experience working with community-based organizations and
underserved populations.
The successful candidate must be able to lift 50 pounds,
navigate stairs, and maneuver racks of costumes between adjacent
buildings.
Must possess and maintain an acceptable driving record in
accordance with University policy.

Preferred Qualifications

MFA degree in Costume Technology

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
